# @forge/util

`@forge/util` bundles private Atlassian packages into public modules for Forge CLI consumers.
Expose only the names that consumers in this monorepo need.

## Build

For development, `bolt install` from the repository root builds util automatically.
The [build script](scripts/build.sh) uses [webpack](webpack.config.js) to bundle the exports in [src](src/) into CommonJS modules under `packages/`.
ARI declarations remain available to workspace consumers and are excluded from the published package.

## Add exports to an existing package

Find the package's entry file through [webpack.config.js](webpack.config.js).
Add the required named exports to that file under `src/`.
The ARI declaration entry uses the same export list, so it updates with the bundle.
Update the expected exports in the [package integration tests](__test__/bundle.integration.test.ts).

## Add another package

1. Add the package to util's `devDependencies` with `yarn bolt w @forge/util add --dev <package>`.
   Run the command from the repository root.
2. Add an entry file under `src/` that exports only the required names.
3. Connect the entry through `webpack.config.js` and expose its generated path through [package.json](package.json) `exports`.
4. If workspace consumers need types, extend `scripts/build.sh` to prepare declarations beside the bundle.
5. Extend the package integration tests to load the new module and assert its public exports.
